$comment: Hand-written engineering log for /testing, in public language: what was tested, what was seen, what changed. No names, tools, suppliers, prices or datasheet figures. sync-testing.mjs validates it and copies published entries into public/testing/index.json. figureId must name a published figure.

items.tested: Thrust map at 16:48 UTC on one 6S pack: ten throttle holds, 10 to 100 percent.
items.saw: 1652 g at 31283 rpm at 100 percent throttle; pack 23.9 V at rest; ESC temperature live, 38 to 53 C; zero drift 2 g before, 0.5 g after. The 16:35 UTC capture is not used: zero drift up to 27 g and a frozen ESC temperature.
items.changed: ESC temperature now stays live after a pack swap.

items.tested: Thrust map on the new thrust stand: ten throttle holds, 10 to 100 percent.
items.saw: 13:25 UTC run: 1496 g at 100 percent. 13:16 UTC run: the operator unplugged the pack at 80 percent because of the noise, and the throttle profile kept stepping to full with no pack.
items.changed: The bench controller aborts when the bus voltage disappears under command. Stand test plans no longer include a current cut.

items.tested: Continuous current rating by a fixed-current step and the die temperature settling.
items.saw: Not captured. From the fitted thermal time constant of 5 to 10 minutes, 20 s at the target current gives only a few percent of the steady rise, so a pack step cannot reach steady state.
items.changed: The bench holds a target die temperature and reads the current needed.

items.tested: Review of the scope captures from the destructive ramp session.
items.saw: Scope channel 1 read one constant value in all nine sessions of that afternoon; no check flagged it.

items.tested: Throttle sweep against a clamp reference.
items.saw: The sense reading did not track the clamp: 11.6 A against 32.4 A at 80 percent, 64.7 A against 55.7 A at 100 percent.
items.changed: Input network added to the sense amplifier in rev3.2; no capture after the change.

items.tested: One channel ramped from 0 to full throttle with no thermal guard.
items.saw: Clamp current peaked at 39.8 A with the die at 156 C; the die reached 161 C and bus voltage telemetry stopped.

items.tested: First boards flashed for the bench.
items.saw: Boards left the flashing step with the temperature limit at 255 and a default motor preset.
items.changed: Both are now set per product in the flashing jig.

items.tested: First flights of the full stack on five drones.
items.saw: 103 blackbox logs from four drones, about half arm and disarm blips; the fifth drone's SD card failed. Seven logs on the 8 inch ran the FC on a separate battery, so their voltage is not pack voltage.

items.tested: Ride out to 5.3 km with a Gemini and a Mono on the same carry.
items.saw: Beyond 2.9 km the Gemini's RSSI was below the Mono's in 24 of 25 bins, by a median of 4 dB, and its link quality was higher in all 25, by a median of 15 points. Receiver columns come from the operators' notes; one duplicate column was excluded.
